CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArraySwap

Exchanges the values at two positions of an array.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArraySwap(array, position1, position2)

Parameters

array
The array to change.
position1
Position of the first element.
position2
Position of the second element.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Both positions must exist; otherwise an Expression exception ("Array index out of range") is thrown. ArraySwap is the building block of hand-written shuffles and sorts.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Podium = ListToArray("Silver,Gold,Bronze")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #ArrayToList(Podium, " | ")#</P>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySwap(Podium, 1, 2)>
<P>After ArraySwap(Podium, 1, 2): #ArrayToList(Podium, " | ")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArraySort, ArrayInsertAt, ArrayDeleteAt
